ESTABLISHING STILL of Golden Gaya, intro-card painted world, same film stock: watercolor-and-oil, 2.5D timber and giwa, manga ink on the roofs, NOT photoreal, NOT a 3D architectural visualization. FAR WIDE, slight bird's-eye. ONE DEVICE: the palace courtyard of the attached board — KEEP this exact layout (central hall, two-tier giwa, flanking pavilions, packed-earth court, stone wall). IGNORE cars, vans, streetlights, modern people on the board. Dusk, one hard key, long shadows, crushed darks. Tiny anonymous silhouette on the court. Purple #8B5CF6 a thin cloth accent on a banner, never a glow. No text. PAINTED STILL — no faces and no recognisable person: the only figure is one anonymous dark silhouette, a shadow-shape against the light that belongs to the place; the place or object IS the subject. Sensual and suggestive by shape and motion alone, never anatomical, never explicit. A 2:1 movie frame composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop (nothing important at the top or bottom edge). Hand-painted WATERCOLOR-AND-OIL: granulated wet-in-wet washes and broken-colour dabs for sky, water and stone, dry-brush texture, soft bleeding edges and a faint paper grain; oil glazes deepen the darks and a touch of impasto lands on the single brightest highlight. Romantic-painting layout: one bold shape, at least half the frame quiet negative space, distant detail dissolving into haze. Film tenebrism: one hard directional key (sun, moon or lamp) against big dark masses, a thin edge of real light along the subject, painted bokeh from small real lights. Beautiful, luminous, painterly. NOT photoreal, NOT 3D, NOT a cartoon. No text. No watermark. NIGHT GROUND: the frame is built on BLACK — crushed ink-black night masses around the subject, the place pulled out of the dark only where the one key light (fire, lamp, torch, moon) falls, small warm bokeh in the black; the figure is the bright thing in a dark frame.
